tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.28.7
§ Elkanah = "God has possessed" or "God has created"
1) Samuel's father
2) a ruler in Jerusalem in the time of king Ahaz
3) one of David's mighty warriors
4) son of Korah
5) several Levites

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Elkanah, the name of several Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H410 (אֵל) and H7069 (קָנָה); God has obtained;
